card.summary: No published total quota; per-post caps only. Effectively unlimited posts.

free_tier.stated: No published total quota; per-post caps only. Effectively unlimited posts.

egress.terms: Free viewing, but images are re-encoded and served via i.pximg.net with a Referer check that blocks hotlinking from other origins. Not a usable direct-link CDN.

record.tooling: No official public upload API. pixivpy works for read; upload requires session-cookie replay and 2FA-prone flows.
record.chaining: Unlimited accounts x unlimited posts x 32 MB. The 32 MB per-illustration cap is generous for an image host.
record.limits_note: Profile images are limited to 5 MB per image; illustration posts can be a maximum of 32 MB; all images in a manga post must be 200 MB or less; profile workspace and design images up to 1 MB. There are no limits on the number of works or posts.
record.reliability_note: Referer-gated CDN means links are not freely hotlinkable, and re-encode is standard. Fails direct-link permanence.
